pipeline.name: clearfelt-humanize
pipeline.config: Read empathy_threshold, max_iterations, and intensity from clearfelt.config.md, layered under any ~/.clearfelt/settings.md global override and any .clearfelt/domain.md preferred_intensity project override. Do not hardcode these values here; the config files are the single source of truth.

pass.name: extract_and_calibrate
pass.goal: Establish what must be preserved, decide how much rewriting to do, and get explicit sign-off before anything is rewritten.

steps.step: Read the target file in full.

Extract the factual payload: claims, numbers, names, dates, quotes, and any citations present. These must survive every later pass unchanged. Do not add facts, names, dates, or citations that are not already in the source (no-fabrication rule).

Check for .clearfelt/voice-profile.md (or .clearfelt/voices/<name>.md in multi-voice mode) in the user's project. If present, read it and note preferred vocabulary, sentence rhythm notes, and non-negotiables. A voice-profile preference always overrides a default rule file entry for this run.

Check .clearfelt/domain.md for a risk_tier field. If it is set to "sensitive", note this for Pass 2 (hedges and qualifiers must never be rewritten away) and force the confirm-before-write gate on for this run, regardless of humanize.require_confirmation in clearfelt.config.md or any saved global preference. Mention once, plainly, that this project is marked sensitive and why that changes the run.
If no voice-profile.md exists, note that bundled defaults apply and continue without blocking; offer to run "/clearfelt setup" once, but do not require it.
Run: node scripts/detect.mjs --mode report <path>. This scored hit list carries forward into Pass 2 for light_touch; do not re-run it there.

Also run: node scripts/detect.mjs --mode scan <path>. This returns every occurrence of every rule-dictionary word or phrase, including ones tier-suppression hid from the scored report. Carries forward into Pass 2 for balanced and above; do not re-run it there either.

Build a to-do preview from the report hits (not the scan list, which is usually much longer and not meant as a preview), following reference/output-format.md's to-do-list template: a table of category/pattern/line, not a paragraph.

Resolve the intensity to run at, in this order: .clearfelt/domain.md's preferred_intensity field (project-level, if present) beats ~/.clearfelt/settings.md's intensity/humanize.ask_intensity (global save, if present) beats clearfelt.config.md's shipped default (humanize.ask_intensity: true means ask).

If asking (no resolved preference): present the to-do preview plus the four-tier table (light_touch, balanced, full_rewrite, structural_rework; see reference/humanize.md for the full description of each) as the question. Note the target's existing paragraph structure and approximate length while presenting this, since only light_touch and balanced must preserve these exactly. After the user picks a tier, ask a second, separate question: save this choice, and if so, globally (writes to ~/.clearfelt/settings.md, applies to every project using this skill install) or just for this project (writes preferred_intensity to .clearfelt/domain.md, creating it from templates/domain.example.md if needed)? Do not save anything without this explicit second answer.

If not asking (a resolved preference already exists): show the to-do preview as a brief FYI, state which intensity is being used and why (saved preference, project- or global-scoped), and mention how to change it. Proceed without blocking.

pass.name: scrub_slop
pass.goal: Remove confirmed antipattern and banned-word hits, then apply warmth metrics at the resolved intensity.

steps.step: Respect the resolved intensity. Each tier is a strict superset of the one below it: light_touch: rewrite only the spans in Pass 1's report hit list. Paragraph count, paragraph order, and sentence count stay exactly as in the source. balanced: rewrite every occurrence in Pass 1's scan list (not just the report hit list), which includes words tier-suppression hid from the score, plus contractions and casual-transition swaps ("Plus" instead of "Furthermore") applied throughout the document. No sentence restructuring, no paragraph changes. full_rewrite: everything in balanced, plus deliberate sentence-length variation (mix short punchy sentences with longer ones), a shift toward collective pronouns ("we" instead of "the user"), and addressing reference/audit.md's "Qualitative signals" (frictionless claims, narrative idiosyncrasy, episodic grounding, cognitive friction) as real rewrite targets. Paragraph count and order still preserved. structural_rework: everything in full_rewrite, plus willing to add missing paragraph breaks, split or merge paragraphs, reorder sentences within a paragraph, and trim throat-clearing or padding sentences for real conciseness. Every tier remains bounded by the no-fabrication rule and voice-profile precedence. A word the user has a genuine reason to keep belongs in .clearfelt/domain.md's exemption list, checked before any of the above runs, not preserved by relying on tier-suppression, which protects the score, not humanize's editing scope.

If Pass 1 found risk_tier: sensitive, skip every rewrite that would remove or soften a frictionless_claims or weasel_attribution hit, at every intensity tier, including structural_rework. This overrides the tier-scope rules above for those two categories specifically; everything else about the resolved tier still applies.
Apply contractions where natural (don't, you're, we'll) unless the voice profile says otherwise. This applies at every intensity tier, including light_touch.

On a re-entry into this pass from the loop below, increase burstiness and structural variation further than the previous attempt, still bounded by the resolved intensity's scope, the no-fabrication rule, and voice-profile precedence.

pass.name: warmth_evaluation
pass.goal: Score the current draft and decide whether another scrub pass is needed.

steps.step: Compare the returned score against empathy_threshold.

pass.loop: Re-run pass 2 with the "re-entry" instruction above. If max_iterations is reached without clearing the threshold, stop and report the final score honestly rather than looping forever.
